name: HVAC Template 1
archetype: Dark immersive · thermostat-dial hero · cooling/heating split (its own layout, NOT the split-hero card-grid used by 01-plumber / 02-roofing)
design_style: Comfort-tech polish on a DARK immersive hero. Cool 'cooling' blue → warm 'heating' orange duality, expressed as a thermostat-dial gauge. Poppins + Open Sans, pill components, transparent header that solidifies on scroll.
best_for: Residential HVAC contractors in dual-season climates (hot summers + cold winters) running BOTH 24/7 emergency repair and scheduled installs/maintenance, pushing a maintenance membership.
demo_brand: TrueComfort Heating & Air (Kansas City), placeholder identity, swap per client

library_sources.palette: ui-ux-pro-max colors.csv row 55 'Home Services' (professional blue + urgent orange), adapted into a dark cool/warm duality
library_sources.fonts: ui-ux-pro-max typography.csv row 2 'Modern Professional' (Poppins + Open Sans)

sections: transparent header → solidifies white on scroll (distinct from 01/02's always-solid header)
DARK hero: copy + thermostat-dial gauge centerpiece (no framed stock photo)
services: COOLING | HEATING two-column split + extra pills (NOT a 3-up icon-card grid)
why us: tall photo panel w/ overlay badge + numbered 01-04 bordered panel
Comfort Club: wide horizontal membership banner
process: vertical timeline w/ gradient spine (NOT horizontal cards)
reviews: one large featured quote + two small cards
book: dark split + prominent white form
signature_features: Thermostat-dial hero gauge, cool→warm gradient arc, '72° COMFORT', COOL/HEAT labels (the hot/cold duality built into the hero, no stock photo)
Cooling | Heating split services layout (reinforces the duality)
Vertical process timeline with a blue→orange gradient spine
Comfort Club membership banner (the HVAC retention/proof element)
Transparent-over-dark header that solidifies to white on scroll
motion: Minimum-animation per brief. Vanilla JS only, IntersectionObserver scroll-reveal, transparent→solid + hide-on-scroll header, FAQ accordion. NO perpetual background loops. Every animation honors prefers-reduced-motion.

delivery.format: single-file index.html, no local asset dependencies (the dial is inline SVG)
delivery.remote_images: Pexels, why-panel tech (32588555). og:image (5463575). Hero uses the SVG dial, not a photo. Swap photos for the client's real tech/van shots.
